description: A web application that lets users browse, create, and manage recipes with detailed nutrition facts, and generate weekly meal plans with nutrition summaries.
core_features: User registration, login, and profile management
Browse, search, and view recipes with nutrition facts
Create, edit, and delete personal recipes
Generate and edit weekly meal plans from selected recipes
View aggregated nutrition summary for each weekly plan
future_features: Automatic grocery list generation from weekly plans
Integration with external nutrition APIs for richer data
Share and collaborate on meal plans with other users

milestones: Implement user authentication and profile CRUD
Create REST APIs for Recipe and MealPlan entities
Build basic React UI for login, registration, and recipe CRUD
Add recipe search and nutrition display
Develop weekly meal‑plan editor with drag‑and‑drop
Show aggregated nutrition summary for weekly plans
Generate grocery lists from meal plans
Enable plan sharing and collaboration features
